# CLUSTER_STORE

A named store an ExternalSecret reads from, and whether it may be written to.

<!-- Generated by nix build .#referencePages -->

Written `sigs.CLUSTER_STORE`.

Canonically `clusterStore`. A floe providing this must declare it
as `provides.clusterStore`; a hole that resolves it may be called
anything.
